papers.title: Effects of Process Parameters on the Surface Roughness of Stainless Steel 316L Parts Produced by Selective Laser Melting
papers.abstract: Abstract Selective Laser Melting (SLM) is an additive manufacturing method that is used to fabricate different types of complex components using a layer-by-layer approach. The parts are produced directly from three-dimensional computer-aided design data by melting the powdered material layer-by-layer with the aid of laser power. In this work, an experimental investigation of the process parameters of the SLM method using stainless steel 316L powder was conducted. The influence of laser power, scanning speed, and hatching distance on the surface roughness of the specimens was investigated. The design of experiment was conducted using Taguchi’s L16 orthogonal array. Furthermore, statistical analysis using signal-to-noise (S/N) response and analysis of variance (ANOVA) was used to obtain the optimal parameter combinations of the SLM process. From the experimental results, it was found that laser power has the greatest effect on the surface roughness relative to scanning speed and hatching distance. Moreover, using regression analysis, the predicted values of surface roughness and signal-to-noise ratios were obtained. The predicted values were then compared with the experimental values. Lastly, shot peening technique was used to improve the surface roughness of the manufactured components. The results show that the shot peening process offers about 33.28 % reduction in the surface roughness of the manufactured parts.

summary_zh.motivation: 优化SLM工艺参数以降低316L不锈钢零件表面粗糙度。
summary_zh.method: 采用Taguchi L16正交实验和ANOVA分析激光功率、扫描速度和扫描间距的影响。
summary_zh.result: 激光功率影响最大，喷丸处理可降低表面粗糙度约33%。
summary_zh.validation: 通过回归分析预测值与实验值对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: To optimize SLM process parameters for minimizing surface roughness of stainless steel 316L parts.
summary_en.method: Taguchi L16 orthogonal array and ANOVA were used to investigate effects of laser power, scanning speed, and hatching distance on surface roughness.
summary_en.result: Laser power had the greatest influence on surface roughness, and shot peening reduced surface roughness by approximately 33%.
summary_en.validation: Predicted values from regression analysis were compared with experimental measurements.

papers.title: Effect of laser energy density on microstructures and mechanical properties of selective laser melted Ti-6Al-4V alloy
papers.abstract: Abstract Ti-6Al-4V samples were fabricated by selective laser melting (SLM) with a series of different laser energy inputs. The microstructure presented a feature of fine acicular martensite due to the high cooling rate of the SLM process. All the relative density, micro-hardness and tensile properties initially increased and then decreased with increasing laser energy density. The fracture morphology exhibited a mixed mode of complex ductile and brittle fracture. All the results indicated that the laser energy density has a crucial effect on the microstructures and mechanical properties of the SLMed Ti-6Al-4V alloy. The correlations between the laser energy density and the microstructures and mechanical properties of the SLMed Ti-6Al-4V alloy were studied.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了SLM Ti-6Al-4V合金的激光能量密度对微观结构和力学性能的影响，但未涉及多孔结构、应力屏蔽、疲劳或骨整合等生物医学植入物相关特性。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address porous structure design, fatigue testing, or osseointegration properties; it only studies laser energy density effects on microstructure and static mechanical properties without a biomedical implant context.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究激光能量密度对SLM Ti-6Al-4V合金微观结构和力学性能的影响。
summary_zh.method: 通过改变激光能量密度参数进行SLM成型，观测微观组织并测试密度、显微硬度和拉伸性能。
summary_zh.result: 激光能量密度增加时，相对密度、显微硬度和拉伸性能先升后降，微观组织为针状马氏体。
summary_zh.validation: 通过实验测试密度、硬度、拉伸性能和断口形貌验证。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of laser energy density on the microstructure and mechanical properties of selective laser melted Ti-6Al-4V alloy.
summary_en.method: Ti-6Al-4V samples were fabricated by SLM under varying laser energy densities, and the resulting microstructures and mechanical properties were characterized.
summary_en.result: Relative density, micro-hardness, and tensile properties initially increased and then decreased with increasing laser energy density, and the microstructure consisted of fine acicular martensite.
summary_en.validation: Experimental validation through measurements of density, micro-hardness, tensile properties, and fracture morphology.

papers.title: Effect of high-frequency loading and parathyroid hormone administration on peri-implant bone healing and osseointegration.
papers.abstract: The objective of this study is to examine the effect of low-magnitude, high-frequency (LMHF) loading, and anti-osteoporosis medications such as parathyroid hormone (PTH) and bisphosphonates on peri-implant bone healing in an osteoporosis model, and to assess their combined effects on these processes. Thirteen-week-old ovariectomized rats (n = 44) were divided into three groups: PTH, alendronate, and saline. After 3 weeks of drug administration, titanium implants were inserted into the tibiae. Each group was subdivided into two groups: with or without LMHF loading via whole-body vibration (50 Hz at 0.5 g, 15 min per day, 5 days per week). Rats were killed 4 weeks following implantation. Removal torque test, micro-CT analyses (relative gray (RG) value, water = 0, and implant = 100), and histomorphometric analyses (bone-to-implant contact (BIC) and peri-implant bone formation (bone volume/tissue volume (BV/TV))) were performed. Removal torque values and BIC were significantly differed by loading and drug administration (ANOVA). Post hoc analysis showed that PTH-treated groups were significantly higher than the other drug-treated groups. BV/TV was significantly enhanced by PTH administration. In cortical bone, RG values were significantly increased by loading. In trabecular bone, however, RG values were significantly increased by PTH administration. These findings suggest that LMHF loading and PTH can act locally and additively on the bone healing process, improving the condition of implant osseointegration.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究药物和机械加载对骨整合的影响，不涉及增材制造、应力遮挡或植入物力学测试。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not involve LPBF fabrication, mechanical testing, stress shielding, or any additive manufacturing context.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究高频加载和药物对骨质疏松模型中骨整合的影响
summary_zh.method: 大鼠卵巢切除模型，植入钛钉，施加振动加载和药物
summary_zh.result: PTH和加载协同促进骨整合，提高去除扭矩和骨接触
summary_zh.validation: 动物实验通过Micro-CT和组织形态学验证

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the combined effects of low-magnitude high-frequency loading and anti-osteoporosis drugs on peri-implant bone healing in an osteoporotic rat model.
summary_en.method: Ovariectomized rats received titanium implants with PTH, alendronate, or saline, and half were subjected to whole-body vibration.
summary_en.result: PTH treatment significantly increased removal torque and bone-to-implant contact, and loading enhanced cortical bone density.
summary_en.validation: In vivo animal study using removal torque, micro-CT, and histomorphometric analyses.
